TITLE: Apple Reminders
DESC: Apple Reminders CLI for AI agents: list, search and (policy-gated) create/complete reminders via EventKit.
INJECTION: Static JXA script (`go:embed`). Input travels only as one JSON argv element to `/usr/bin/osascript` (absolute path), and fuzz tests check the script is never altered by input. An integration test round-trips hostile strings through real osascript.
SECRETS: No credentials involved; macOS TCC controls access.
ONELINER: Read and manage Apple Reminders from the command line, built for AI coding agents.
PERMISSION_HINT: macOS has not granted Reminders access to the app that runs the CLI
INTEGRATION_NOTE: The Reminders tests create a list named `agent-cli-test-<random>` and delete it at the end.
AGENT_TASK: the user's reminders and to-do lists
FIRST_RUN: On the first run macOS asks whether your terminal app may access Reminders.
NETWORK_SECTION: `apple-reminders` makes no network connections. Reminders stay in EventKit on your Mac, and iCloud syncs them as usual.
